title: Source-only Meta WhatsApp ingress authority policy for frozen B02
out_of_scope: deploy / cloud / database / Stripe / production WhatsApp operations

resolveMetaWhatsAppIngressAuthority.disabled: authority_policy_disabled — invoke_downstream true, live slug unchanged

applyMetaWhatsAppIngressAuthority.active_known: sets client_slug + location_id from shadow; records ingress_authority
applyMetaWhatsAppIngressAuthority.active_blocked: does not switch live tenant; ingress_authority.blocked=true

shouldBlockMetaWhatsAppIngressDownstream.behavior: true only when authority active + blocked — inbound skips draft/send/DB

processMetaWhatsAppWebhookPostEntry.behavior: normalize + authority gate before withPgClient; blocked → acquired_pg=false and zero pool/inbound/persist/draft/send/owner/demo; known authoritative tenant+location reach real draft/send builders, persistence seed, response.normalized, and location-scoped idempotency

processMetaWhatsAppWebhookInbound.behavior: authority block returns before find/insert/draft/send (zero downstream)

buildDraftInputFromNormalized.behavior: includes trusted normalized.location_id when present; omits key when absent (legacy)

buildMetaWebhookSendBody.behavior: includes location_id when present; idempotency via buildMetaInboundIdempotencyKey

residual_risk.summary: Policy remains default-off. Live B02 stays vulnerable until an operator separately enables META_WHATSAPP_INGRESS_AUTHORITY and provides CLIENT_CHANNEL_ROUTING_* with verified phone_number_id maps. Enabling without accurate routing will hard-block unknown numbers. Wolfhouse registry client_slug is wolfhouse while legacy DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG is wolfhouse-somo — authority mode uses resolver client_slug.
